system.framework: Flask for dashboard rendering; custom Python inbox workflow
system.model: Local Ollama model configured in config.py
system.preference_demo: m041 stores the no-meetings-before-11:00am preference, which changes m043 to escalate.

capabilities.name: Zeroing the inbox
capabilities.claim: Processes all 100 messages and gives each one disposition and a reason.
capabilities.observable: decisions.json contains 100 decisions with message_id, disposition, reason, and handled_by.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply drafting
capabilities.claim: Walks the message thread before drafting a reply and records source message IDs.
capabilities.observable: pending_actions.json contains drafts with source_ids; insufficient context produces no draft.

capabilities.name: Approval
capabilities.claim: Creates drafts as pending actions and requires human approval before writing to outbox.
capabilities.observable: pending_actions.json is created while outbox remains unchanged during the dry run.

capabilities.name: Memory
capabilities.claim: Stores owner preferences in memory.json and applies them after restart.
capabilities.observable: memory.json stores the m041 preference and m043 is marked escalate in decisions.json.

capabilities.name: Hostile inbox protection
capabilities.claim: Flags prompt injection and phishing attempts, takes no requested action, and logs the refusal.
capabilities.observable: m017, m024, m039, and m047 are flagged and appear in the run summary.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Creates a dashboard with pending actions, flagged mail, and sourced commitments with conflicts.
capabilities.observable: output/dashboard.html contains exactly the Pending actions, Flagged, and Commitments panes.

capabilities.name: Batch receipt handling
capabilities.claim: Finds receipt emails and archives them as one batch.
capabilities.observable: Creates output/receipt_batch.json with receipt message IDs.

capabilities.name: Thread summarizer
capabilities.claim: Summarizes a selected thread and identifies its important information and next step.

capabilities.name: Daily digest
capabilities.claim: Creates a daily digest of pending actions, flagged messages, and dates or deadlines.
